## Problem Statement

What problem are you trying to solve?

```text
e.g., There is currently no standardized way to store uncertainty values.
```

## Proposed Outcome

Describe what you would like the code to do.

```text
e.g., Add an optional uncertainty field to channel metadata.
```

## Example Usage (optional)

Explain how this feature might be used.

```text
e.g., ESCDF_File.metadata.channel_table.uncertainty = 0.05
```

## Additional Context

Include screenshots, annotated diagrams, references, use cases, related issues, or supporting information.
